# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Jul 29, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on July 29 focused on critical production stability, specifically resolving a P0 failure in agent deletion workflows. The team also made significant progress in hardening the calendar source-completeness suite, improving CI/CD reliability, and performing a comprehensive dependency and tooling sweep.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

**Production Stability & Lifecycle Fixes**
*   Resolved a P0 production issue where agent deletion retries were crashing due to timestamp serialization errors ([#17260](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17260)).
*   Refactored deletion logic to prevent unnecessary re-writing of `deletion_started_at` timestamps during retry cycles ([#17251](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17251)).
*   Implemented stricter Android component auditing to reject relocated privileged AAB components ([#17257](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17257)).

**UI, CI, and Infrastructure Hardening**
*   Repaired chronic regressions in the UI Story Gate and Windows CI environments ([#17264](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17264), [#17266](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17266)).
*   Fixed cloud-settings token scan failures on Windows caused by path separator inconsistencies ([#17259](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17259)).

**Dependency Management & Tooling**
*   Executed a comprehensive dev-dependency sweep, including Biome updates and regenerated lockfiles ([#17291](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17291)).
*   Updated various dependencies across the `uv` group, Capacitor plugins, and Anthropic SDKs ([#17183](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17183), [#17281](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17281), [#17280](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17280), [#17279](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17279)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
*   **Cloud & Infrastructure:** [#17283](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17283) (Backporting deletion fix), [#17284](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17284), [#17285](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17285), [#17286](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17286), [#17287](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17287), [#17265](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17265), [#17263](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17263), [#17262](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17262), [#17258](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17258).
*   **Core & Plugins:** [#17290](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17290) (Lockfile sync), [#17289](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17289) (Aomi on-chain execution), [#17270](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17270) (Memory uniqueness), [#17261](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17261) (Workspace references).
*   **CI/CD:** [#17269](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17269) (Exhaustive gates).
*   **Dependencies:** [#17282](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17282), [#17278](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17278).

## CLOSED ISSUES
*   *None reported for this period.*

## NEW ISSUES
*   **Verification & Contracts:** [#17268](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17268) regarding deterministic verification defects on Windows and UI.
*   **Plugin Integration:** [#17288](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17288) regarding the Aomi on-chain execution integration.

## ACTIVE ISSUES
*   **[#12080](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/12080) (Live Showcase Deploys):** Recent nightly runs confirm failures in EDAD and Clone Ur Crush deployments. The team identified deep architectural defects, including lack of durable deployment entities and race conditions in concurrency guards. A proposal for a first-class, org-scoped deployment record is under review.
*   **[#13100](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13100) (Payout Rails):** The payout-rail branch is currently held due to safety gaps, specifically the lack of enforcement for the Base-USDC-only launch policy and risks of double-payment during stale-lock recovery.
*   **[#15783](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/15783) (PGlite Backup RPO):** Work continues on the durable backup scheduler. The team is addressing fleet-health implementation and backup starvation issues, with a focus on ensuring 100% of agents have restorable backups.
*   **[#17007](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17007) (Organization Inference Admission):** Nightly regressions show 503 errors during app monetization warm-up. The team is working to unify admission gates across chat surfaces and implement fail-closed cache warming.
*   **[#17176](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17176) (Calendar Availability):** The team successfully landed the calendar source-completeness work. While the agent-facing gap is closed, the issue remains open pending real provider logs and multi-account OAuth verification.
*   **[#17179](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17179) (Co-parent Persona):** The persona and corpus work has landed. The team is hardening the grading machinery, moving away from string matching toward citation-gated LLM verdicts.
*   **[#17249](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17249) (Agent Deletion Failure):** This P0 issue is nearing resolution. The root cause—a serialization error in retry logic—has been identified and fixed in staging. Backporting and production deployment are underway to clear the backlog of stuck agents.
